partido: Mourinho returns to Rome: Roma 3-4 Real Madrid
text:
Roma fans welcomed Mourinho back with a banner: "Bentornato Special One". Roma led 3-1 at 82 minutes. Real Madrid won 4-3. Welcome back or not? 👇
